content: Buf CLI latest v1.75.0 (2026-10-22, GitHub Releases API verified). buf.gen.yaml v2 supports local plugins: local: <binary-on-PATH> or command list; pattern local: go tool protoc-gen-go runs Go-1.24+-tool-directive-pinned plugins without protoc or PATH installs; buf replaces the protoc C++ binary entirely for codegen.
